decodability_rule: Kiswahili orthography is transparent and predominantly open-CV. A word is accessible to the student if it is a known sight word, OR it can be segmented into syllables (standalone vowel V; onset+vowel where the onset is a single consonant, digraph, nasal/prenasalized cluster, or consonant+glide; or a syllabic nasal) such that every unit used is in the student's known_graphemes.

reference_inventory.comment: Full inventory of sw orthographic units, independent of any student
